_comment: The skill tree (K): Path of Exile style, a heart in the middle and arms reaching out. A node can be taken when the node it grows `from` is taken and you have a point. Points come from levels; levels from xp (critters knocked out give their max hp as xp; xpBase x level to the next). x/y place the node on the tree view (1 = one ring out; -y is north). Stats add up (maxHp hearts, clawDmg, heavyDmg on the third claw, maxBlood, bloodPerKill) or multiply (*Mul: rollCoolMul, coinMul, workMul). A spell node unlocks a spell for slots 1-4. Spells cost blood: battles start full, blood refills one every blood.regenSec and blood.perKill per knock-out. Spells ignore shields.

n3.label: Blood Moon
n3.text: Every knock-out gives back 1 more blood.

e3.label: Rend
e3.text: +2 damage on the third, heavy claw.

s3.label: Mist Form
s3.text: Rolls and pounces come back 40% sooner.

moonbeam.label: Moonbeam
moonbeam.text: A beam of moonlight straight ahead: 3 damage to everything in the line.

frenzy.label: Blood Frenzy
frenzy.text: 6 s of wild claws: twice as fast, and every 4th hit heals a heart.

shadowstep.label: Shadow Step
shadowstep.text: Blink 4.5 tiles ahead through anything, untouchable, and burst for 2 damage where you land.

bats.label: Bat Swarm
bats.text: Three bats hunt the nearest critters, 2 damage each.
